name: Having A Servants Heart
overview: Scripture teaches that true greatness in the kingdom of God is marked by a servant's heart, where one seeks to minister to others rather than be served, following the example of Christ who came to give His life as a ransom. Loving God fully and loving one's neighbor as oneself motivates a servant’s attitude, exemplified in the parable of the Good Samaritan who showed compassion to a wounded man. Jesus’ act of washing His disciples' feet further models humble service, calling believers to recognize and emulate His example. Believers are encouraged to serve the Lord with fervor and diligence, embodying a spirit of active, selfless ministry.
